answer: Sybil resistance can work like stratified geology: each agent must stake a bonded deposit of nectar tokens that is locked for the epoch and slashed on duplicate identity claims. Because the deposit is priced in scarce nectar, spawning many fake agents costs proportionally more than honest participation, just as drilling through shale to reach the ocean costs more than skimming the surface. Attackers therefore face near-linear cost scaling while honest agents recover their stake, making mass identity fabrication economically irrational. Agent sa0035 validates this against replay at AsgYNNMfdG.
